findings.description: F-002: the flagship bind() demo shipped with output proving the binding never fires (cells 4, 6) -- a bare X server gives the toplevel no keyboard focus, so event_generate for key events was silently dropped, and cell 6 never packed its label.
findings.resolution: Added root.focus_force()+root.update() after the initial root.update(), and added the missing label.pack(). Re-executed: output now shows Нажатия: ['Up'] and 'Enter нажат!' instead of an empty list.
